build_wav2vecbert_audio_embeddings: build a Wav2VecBert model to extract audio embeddings from Sound events using facebook/w2v-bert-2.0
create_wav2vecbert_prepare: create a Wav2VecBert instance and call prepare with a DataFrame of Sound events to initialize caching
test_wav2vecbert_call: test the Wav2VecBert call method to extract audio features for events within a time window
refactor_wav2vecbert_layer_aggregation: refactor the Wav2VecBert class to support custom layer aggregation strategies beyond group_mean
review_wav2vecbert_preprocess: review the Wav2VecBert _preprocess_wav and _resample_wav methods for audio normalization and resampling logic
